description: This file defines a Dart class `HealthService` that provides a method to check the health status of a backend server via an HTTP GET request to the /api/health endpoint.

classes.name: HealthService
classes.description: A service class to perform health checks on the backend server.

methods.name: checkHealth
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the /api/health endpoint and returns true if the server responds with status 200 and the expected message.
